name: Dust Bunny
notes: DRAFT for C13-1 (bestiary-plan.md). A fluffy dust ball that rolls straight at you, then sneezes. Stats are TODO for the Researcher (ENEMY_SCALE). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
tell: wiggles, then red circle at its front
senseiLine: It wiggles before it rolls. Watch, then move.
description: A fluffy dust ball that rolls straight at you, then sneezes.

bestiary.tip: Step aside, or COUNTER the sneeze.

lore.white: Shadow dust gathered in the quiet corners. Calm it, and it puffs away into clean air.
